description: This file contains unit tests for key-value type classes, specifically testing `KeyValueType` with string types and `TextKeyValueType` with `TextFragment` objects, using the Google Test framework.

classes.name: KeyValueType
classes.description: A templated key-value pair class being tested, with methods Key(), Value(), and operators for comparison.

classes.name: TextFragment
classes.description: A class representing a fragment of text, used as a key in TextKeyValueType.

classes.name: TextKeyValueType
classes.description: A templated class associating a TextFragment key with an optional value, with case sensitivity as a template parameter.

classes.name: OptionalType
classes.description: A template class representing an optional value for TextFragment.

methods.name: test_keyvaluetype.simple_keyvaluetype
methods.description: Tests creation, comparison, and key access of KeyValueType instances with string types.

methods.name: test_textkeyvaluetype.simple_textkeyvaluetype
methods.description: Tests creation of TextFragment and TextKeyValueType objects with case sensitivity.
